description: This Java class `JProgressPane` extends `JPanel` and provides a custom component for displaying progress information with a progress bar and status label, often used in GUI applications for showing task progress.

classes.name: JProgressPane
classes.description: A custom Swing panel that contains a label and a progress bar and listens to property changes to update status and progress visually.

methods.name: JProgressPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the progress pane with default size, layout, label, and progress bar.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the label text and progress bar value with the provided status message and percentage.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the internal status string, which can be used when updating the label.

methods.name: propertyChange
methods.description: Handles property change events, specifically updating the progress bar value when the 'progress' property changes.
